name: Job Board API Pipeline (Remotive + Greenhouse + Lever)

parameters.text:
=MISSION
Analyze this job posting and decide if it matches the criteria for a fresher MCA graduate job seeker in India.

Company: {{ $json.company }}
Job URL: {{ $json.job_url }}

Job Description Content:
{{ $json.jd_markdown }}

CRITERIA TO INCLUDE
- Experience: 0-1 years (freshers welcome / new grad / entry level / trainee)
- Target roles: AI Engineer, Java Developer, Full Stack Developer, Python Developer, Associate Software Engineer, Backend Developer, ML Engineer
- Location: India-based or Remote
- Skills expected: Java, Python, React, Node.js, ML, AI, AWS basics

CRITERIA TO SKIP
- Experience required greater than 1 year, or senior/lead/manager/principal titles
- Non-dev roles: QA only, Sales, HR, Support, Marketing, Data Entry
- Mandatory requirement of: Spring Boot, Angular, .NET, C#
- Requires 3+ years experience anywhere in the description

OUTPUT FORMAT (strict — no extra text)
If job matches criteria:
Name: <exact role title>
Link: {{ $json.job_url }}
Reason: <why it fits in one line>

If job does not match:
No matching job because: <brief reason>

options.systemMessage: You are a precise AI job scout for fresher software engineer roles in India. Analyze job descriptions strictly per given criteria. Output ONLY the exact format requested. No preamble, no extra text, no markdown formatting.
